nat_symmetric.fact:bridges_bound: Counts a mechanism that runs only when a symmetric viewer finds no direct parent. Seeds 1 and 4 need no bridge and every viewer plays.

tree_short_of_relays.fact:balance_grants: The count of grants follows how short the tree is on the seed. Every seed takes 2 grants or more and passes its starvation limit.

layer_fold.sjl_p95_s: The threshold of 60 s was set on seed 11. The fold completes at 60 to 64 s on 4 seeds of 5. The threshold needs a decision.
